evidence.title: Grammarly Docs | All-in-one AI Document Editor

name: Grammarly
summary: AI writing assistant that checks grammar and spelling, rewrites sentences and adjusts tone in any app or website.
description: An AI writing partner for clarity, correctness and tone: grammar and spelling suggestions, full-sentence rewrites, tone adjustment, generative AI prompts and a document editor. Works as a browser extension and desktop/mobile apps; free plan plus paid individual, team and enterprise plans.
contains: free plan with grammar, spelling and tone suggestions
paid plan at $12 per member/month billed annually
enterprise plan with confidential mode, roles and permissions
full-sentence rewrites and text generation with AI prompts
used by 40 million people and 50,000 organizations
